command:
set -e
mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$${MINIO_ROOT_USER}" "$${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}"
mc mb --ignore-existing "local/$${MINIO_BUCKET_NAME}"
mc mb --ignore-existing local/templates
mc mb --ignore-existing local/registrant-photos
mc mb --ignore-existing local/documents
exit 0

environment.CSP_HEADER: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data: http://minio.farmer-upstream.localtest.me:9200; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
